notes.title: Patch 0.8010 Leaderboard and QOL
notes.content:
-0.8010-

-Changes-
> Card Mana color for sprites is default slot 1 is blue, slot 2 is red, slot 3 is green and slot 4 is yellow - this way your card mana sprite identifies easily which deck the card belongs to
> First Time Loaders of this game wont have audio maxed out everything will be set to 50%
> Guild Master - Twist of Fate changed -> Discard all cards in hand and for each deck you control where the unit is alive draw cards evenly from them until your hand is full.
> Holding 9 cards renders better in particular with larger party sizes

-Bug Fixes-
>Mac - Cursor Should be fixed on Mac machines users mentioned this was too large
Changes
> Events can be combats again so Lantern isn't useless
>Speed of Run Leaderboard actually functions for both the Demo and Main Game now - the posting of this was based on a boolean Player Defeated this was not a good flag to set this to, instead picked node level because that always increments on boss kill so this correctly behaves in the fact you can only get a score for it if you have won the game
>Flexibility Card not working Guild Master

notes.title: Little Adventure Tale Full Game release!
notes.content:
Hey Gamer's after ages I've finally finished my game Inspired by Slay the Spire! 
I'm a solo developer that works full time so I'm very happy to get something out, though I do acknowledge its not perfect.

In the next coming days I will make updates to the Store Page with an updated trailer and maybe some new GIFS!

I need to increase the Stat counters as well there is well over 280 cards for example. I fell short on some things like Events but might have to revisit that later. The game is likely not perfect I will be working to address any bugs you might find please do reach out.

The important parts are there though I'm excited for you to try the two new Player Classes!

5 Player Classes:
> Knight
> Rogue
> Mage
> Paladin
> Guild Master

9 Non-Player Classes:
> Cleric
> Witch Doctor
> Witch Hunter
> Ranger
> K9
> Shield Seer
> Artificer
> Shaman
> Druid

== 0.8001 ==

- Changes -
> Fixed Reprisal Card for Paladin
> Fix Card Text

== 0.8000 ==

- Changes -
> Improved Ascension Display
> Language Menu easier to access on start screen
> Finished Paladin Class
> Finished Guild Master Class
> Localization Updates

Thank you and have a good weekend!

notes.title: 0.64 Companion Teamwork and Status Card Defence
notes.content:
With this update there are some options in terms of resisting enemy De-buffs and statuses some players have found these too oppressive.

In addition Willpower and Ward did not resist Status Cards at all that's been fixed in terms of this update!
There are more sources of gaining Ward and it should feel better to have Companions in your party.

The trinket total is at 97 too! Almost reaching my goal of 100.

"-0.6315-
-Bug Fixes-
>Trinket needle was using wallet sprite and name and was not set up properly
> Druid battle - druid boss does not load in properly on save and load
> Dark Guild assassin loads properly on save and load
> Companion death refactor - companion dying can be fairly game breaking in some circumstances aimed to add stability on saving and loading as well as companions dying on your turn and the enemy turn by making things clean up less harshly and only when you quit and load

-0.64-
-Companion Changes-
Cleric:
- ward changed to warding aura apply 2 and 3 ward is an aura and is no longer [once]
- prayer draws a card
- inspire adds new buff inspire which increases damage

- chant adds inspire
- revitalization costs 1 mana
Ranger:
- starts with 1 eagle eye
- eagle eye is now common
- reposition is now uncommon and costs 0
Shield Seer:
- starts with 1 seers wisdom
- enmity now adds 2 and then 3 taunt when upgraded
Witch Hunter:
- starts with 1 Providence
- defence against the dark arts adds 3 ward and 5 when upgraded
Witch Doctor:
- starts with 1 Muster Spirit
K9:
- starts with 1 primal strength
- vanguard cost reduced to 1 then 0 when upgraded

-Misc-
- added sprites for most status effects

-Events-
- event nodes can no longer be towns
- new event A Blade and a Foe

-Trinkets-
-Trinket - Amulet
 Adds 2 ward

-Willpower will now correctly attempt to resist Status Cards in all circumstances
-Ward will now correctly attempt to resist Status Cards in all circumstances

notes.title: Little Adventure Tale Demo Live!
notes.content:
[h1]GAMERS! the Demo is out! [/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320370/Little_Adventure_Tale/]DEMOːsteamthisː[/url]
I've launched the Demo I "completed" most of the original checklist and more!

[b]-General-[/b]
> Main Menu Fixes
> Cascade Updated settings window to other scenes
> Hints Update
> Limit Journey to Second Floor
> Localization
> Achievements
> System messages i.e. loading Revamp UI
> UI Pass
> Statistic Serialized File

[b]-Quests-[/b]
>Make sure can fail

[b]-Demo-[/b]
> Create page
> Create Build
> Launch! ːsteamhappyː

In the last update I took stock of content and noted that we didn't have enough events so I've started the Events update along with the demo I've added 8 New events! Some of these come with their own unique enemies, trinkets and cards!

One event had about 16 new trinkets associated with it! I wonder if you can figure out how to get them all!? One of them is really OP a real game changer.

[h2]-[b]Demo Version is 0.6305[/b]-[/h2]
Here is what else I added:

[b]-Polish/Changes-[/b]
>EVENT: Agent of Obradin scales with floor
>EVENT: Ring Trader event added
>EVENT: Quest Board
>EVENT: Mystic Mirror
>EVENT: Golden Boar
>EVENT: Dark Guild
>EVENT: Witches Cauldron
>EVENT: The Madman
>EVENT: Placeholder sprites
>TRINKET: Lantern
>COMPANION: Level Up Dialogue for Companion

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
> Fixed in town item bonuses applying incorrectly
> Fixed smith cost window tooltip overridden by inn window
> Quality of Life quest buttons cancel reward window
> Upgrade card on smith minimum cost as there are a few things that can reduce cost
> Fools Gold functions properly refactored trinket ID
> UI overlap with Event Window
> UI overlap upgrade card with companion panels world map
> Deck button change title to name of companion properly
> Upgrade window destroys temporary cards
> Unique events and event node support unique events properly
>Revitalizing Potion - heals more than 1 hp
> Consumables on world map can target companions proper secondary menu presents itself
> Fixed a Unity Crash with invalid type being assigned to enemy block text

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
> More content - the Events update continue focus on events update we added
8 events so the total is 19 my goal is to have 30 and a stretch would be 50
> Add 2 New Player Classes (sadly these won't be in the Demo)
  > Guild Master
  > Paladin
> Add More Companion Classes

> Bug fixes! Bug Fixes! And addressing Player feedback from Demo! Please leave me some I really want to know what you think.

Thanks and Happy New Year, Merry Christmas and Hope you all have a great 2025!
